changelog: AI-first task manager that turns your spoken thoughts into organized, actionable tasks instantly. Just speak naturally, and Cognary uses AI to prioritize, structure, and manage your to-dos for you. Less effort, more focus — productivity built for the AI era.
display_name: Cognary Tasks is an AI-first task manager that turns your spoken thoughts into organized, actionable tasks instantly. Just speak naturally, and Cognary uses AI to prioritize, structure, and manage your to-dos for you. Less effort, more focus — productivity built for the AI era.
summary: Manage task lists via cognary-cli. Use for listing, adding, updating, completing, uncompleting, and deleting tasks. Triggers on any request about tasks, to-dos, task lists, reminders-as-tasks, or tracking action items.
